entries.title: 发布理论基础与认知模型假说 v1.0.0
entries.summary: 加入完整的中英文研究文档与图示，说明项目的哲学起点、认知链假说及模型模拟方向；首页保留按日研究日志，并提供中英文入口。
entries.title_en: Research Foundations & Cognitive Model Hypothesis v1.0.0
entries.summary_en: Adds the complete research document and diagrams in English and Chinese, presenting the project's philosophical starting point, cognitive-chain hypothesis, and direction for model simulation. The homepage retains the dated research journal and provides both language editions.

entries.title: 首页加入按日研究日志
entries.summary: 按日期展示项目更新，支持筛选页面改动、文件更新和功能更新，并链接相关文件与历史提交。
entries.title_en: Added a daily research journal to the homepage
entries.summary_en: Groups project updates by date, with filters for page changes, file updates, and features, plus links to related files and historical commits.

entries.title: 更新安全规范的实施状态
entries.summary: 明确模型原型尚未实现，区分开发安全要求与经过验证的隔离措施。
entries.title_en: Clarified the implementation status of safety requirements
entries.summary_en: Clarifies that no model prototype has been implemented and distinguishes development safety requirements from verified isolation measures.

entries.title: 上线独立项目介绍网站
entries.summary: 发布 GitHub Pages 首页，将网站和 README 精简为面向访客的项目介绍。
entries.summary_en: Published the GitHub Pages homepage and condensed the website and README into a visitor-facing project introduction.

entries.title: 建立 GitHub 仓库介绍
entries.summary: 补充项目定位、英文摘要与联系信息，公开早期研究方向。
entries.summary_en: Added the project scope, an English abstract, and contact information to present the initial research direction.

entries.title: 建立研究计划与安全文档
entries.summary: 记录研究愿景、可检验假设、原型路线与开发安全边界，作为项目的研究起点。
entries.title_en: Created the research plan and safety documentation
entries.summary_en: Recorded research aims, testable hypotheses, the prototype plan, and development safety boundaries as the starting point for the project.
